Name: Morris in Shipping Bin
Author: Fynzou
Description:
Inspired by SchrodingersKit's Pam in Shipping Bin: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1849, which in turn is inspired by the Demetrius in Shipping Bin mod: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/65

To Install: 

Step 1: Download the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿.
Step 2: Download the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿.
Step 3: Unzip into [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b].
Step 4. Run the game and Enjoy!

Downloads.Description: Morris will appear when you ship items.
